_note: C3 of 4 - viz units for R3 (the meta-modules network, its three levels, node and edge detail) and for the module story pages. Paths and counts are measured survey values.

viz_units.name: Meta-module map (6 supernodes, 15 meta-edges)
viz_units.what_it_shows: The 'meta modules view' of R3 at its most legible: how the six modules connect to each other, weighted by real cross-module edge counts.
viz_units.encoding: A ~760x560 SVG. Six supernodes on a ring ordered by node_select.order_modules() so heavily linked modules are adjacent (M5-M1-M2-M3-M4, with M6 hanging off M1). Node area proportional to carrier genes (M3 4,348 down to M6 1,562). Edge stroke width proportional to cross-module edge count on a sqrt scale; ALL fifteen edges are drawn and labelled - no top-N truncation, because the long tail (M1-M4 = 1 edge) is itself the finding.
viz_units.data_source: BAKE data/graph/meta_edges.json - COMPUTED AT BAKE because no 6x6 adjacency exists anywhere on disk. Four lines of pandas over /Users/wangyanz/Desktop/Project/sequence_design/sequence_analysis_v4_0621/results/phylo_corrected_candidates.csv (2,620 rows) with the cluster->module map expanded from 03.interacting_modules/modules.json. Measured undirected weights: M1-M2 244 (mean score 0.292), M1-M5 192 (0.325), M2-M3 167 (0.266), M1-M6 32 (0.303), M1-M3 30 (0.266), M2-M5 28 (0.248), M3-M4 22 (0.235), M5-M6 15 (0.275), M3-M6 6, M2-M4 5, M2-M6 5, M3-M5 5, M4-M5 4, M1-M4 1, M4-M6 1. Total 757.
interactions: click a supernode -> #/module/M<n>
double-click -> the level-3 bipartite drill-down
click a meta-edge -> level 2 filtered to that module pair (M1-M5 opens the 192 edges the manuscript discusses)
hover an edge -> the other fourteen dim and the top 5 constituent cluster pairs by phylo_corrected_score are listed

viz_units.name: Module supernode glyph
viz_units.what_it_shows: One module as a compound glyph carrying four numbers at once: size, internal density, artifact risk and identity.
viz_units.encoding: A filled disc in the module colour (M1 #0072B2, M2 #CC79A7, M3 #E69F00, M4 #D55E00, M5 #4D4D4D, M6 #009E73) with area proportional to carrier genes; a surrounding ring whose thickness encodes intra-module edge count (M1 774 down to M6 43); the ring's saturation encodes mean_frac_ZNF (M3 0.003 to M1 0.062); the short name and module id inside.
viz_units.data_source: 03.interacting_modules/modules.json (n_protein, n_utr, n_edges, mean_score, mean_indep_clades, mean_frac_ZNF, top_pairs, module_id) + modules_summary.csv + module gene counts from module_gene_members/README.md (M1 3,388, M2 3,046, M3 4,348, M4 1,988, M5 1,607, M6 1,562). Short names from motif_umap/make_individual_figures.py: M1-TF, M2-TF, M3-Secretory, M4-Immune, M5-RNA processing, M6-Translation.
interactions: hover -> all four encoded numbers spelled out in text, because a glyph alone is not evidence

viz_units.name: Meta-edge with weight label

viz_units.encoding: A curved path with the count as a rotated label at the midpoint; direction is deliberately NOT encoded (the underlying counts are directional - M5 protein x M1 UTR = 98 and M1 protein x M5 UTR = 94 - but the meta view shows the undirected sum, with both directions in the tooltip).
viz_units.data_source: data/graph/meta_edges.json
interactions: hover -> both directional counts and the mean phylo_corrected_score
click -> filtered level 2

the level is in the URL

viz_units.name: Module bipartite subgraph
viz_units.what_it_shows: One module as protein clusters on the left and UTR clusters on the right with their edges - the published Fig 3e form.
viz_units.encoding: Two ordered columns. Node order from module_node_ranking.csv weighted degree (or node_select.order_modules() logic), never alphabetical. Circle = protein, square = UTR. Node label colour carries sub-region: 5'UTR #0072B2, 3'UTR #A85A00, protein black - the deliberate second channel from 24_bipartite_pruned_ordered.py lines 69-71. Edge width by phylo_corrected_score (0.146 to 1.769). Edge style tiered: solid where a consensus PAIR backs it, dashed where only cluster-level evidence exists.
viz_units.data_source: phylo_corrected_candidates.csv filtered to mp==mu==module; node sets from modules.json protein_motifs[]/utr_motifs[] (or consensus_scope_clusters.csv, 513 rows of cluster,module,region). Measured per-module subgraphs: M1 106 nodes / 774 edges / density 0.296 / max degree 44; M2 112/409/0.144/40; M3 133/385/0.087/38; M4 73/123/0.116/16; M5 57/126/0.159/17; M6 32/43/0.171/8. Every listed cluster is an active endpoint in all six.
interactions: node/edge selection as in V05
'as published' switch drops to the <=5-per-side subset of intermediate/bipartite_nodes_all6.csv (52 nodes: 25 protein, 27 UTR)
hover a node dims non-adjacent edges

viz_units.name: Full cluster co-occurrence graph
viz_units.what_it_shows: The actual result of the paper: 519 nodes (201 protein + 318 UTR = 251 utr3 + 67 utr5) and 2,620 gated edges, as one connected object.
viz_units.encoding: SVG force graph with a FROZEN bake-time layout. ~519 nodes + 2,620 edges + labels ~= 3,700 elements, comfortably within DOM budget and worth the cost because SVG gives per-element hit-testing, CSS hover and keyboard focus for free - exactly what R3's click-for-details requires. Connected components: one giant component of 513 nodes plus three isolated 2-node dyads (prot_0291 x utr5_0013, prot_0108 x utr3_0355, prot_0058 x utr3_0139), which are shown in an 'ungrouped pairs' corner rather than floating.
viz_units.data_source: BAKE data/graph/nodes.json (519 nodes with frozen x,y, module, region, degree, n_genes, n_instances) and data/graph/edges.json (2,620 edges x 10 fields, a measured 89 KB gzipped). Layout run ONCE at bake with d3-force plus per-module centroid attractors and a protein-left / UTR-right bias, because NO node-level coordinates exist on disk and averaging cca_winner_umap.npy per node does not separate M1/M2/M5/M6 (centroid gaps smaller than within-module std).
interactions: click node -> quick peek; double-click -> cluster page

click edge -> #/pair/

~

hover node -> neighbourhood highlight with everything else at 15% opacity (ported from applyNodeNeighborhoodHighlight in sequence_analysis_v3_0515/04.visualize_motif_interaction/03.build_annotated_plotly_graph.py)
pan/zoom
keyboard: arrow keys walk the neighbour list

viz_units.encoding: Shape = region (circle protein, square UTR). Fill = module colour. Radius by sqrt(n_genes) (24 to 4,571 genes; median 569). Unassigned clusters get a DASHED outline and no fill - never grey fill, because grey is M5's colour. Label below, coloured by sub-region.
viz_units.data_source: data/graph/nodes.json; n_genes from a groupby('motif_cluster').sequence_id.nunique() over identified_motifs_with_clusters.0513.parquet (all 900 clusters, ~66 KB JSON)

click -> drawer

viz_units.name: Network edge glyph with evidence tiering
viz_units.what_it_shows: One co-occurrence pair, with its strength and the quality of the evidence backing it visible in the line itself.
viz_units.encoding: Stroke width by phylo_corrected_score (range 0.1460 to 1.7694, median 0.2757). SOLID where a consensus pair exists, DASHED where only cluster-level evidence does - the same convention as the published figure. Cross-module edges get a slightly lighter stroke but are NOT hidden. Colour is neutral by default; a 'colour by ZNF fraction' mode exists.
viz_units.data_source: data/graph/edges.json from phylo_corrected_candidates.csv (columns protein, utr, co_count, n_indep_families, n_indep_clades, clade_concentration, frac_co_ZNF, npmi_raw, npmi_mip_APC, npmi_reweighted, npmi_family, perm_z_withinfamily, perm_p_withinfamily, passes_phylo_filter, phylo_corrected_score); the consensus-backed flag from intermediate/consensus_pair_scores.csv.gz cl_passes (6,890 rows covering 1,430 of the 1,860 intra-module edges and ZERO cross-module edges).
interactions: hover -> thickens and shows the four gate values inline
click -> the edge drawer

viz_units.data_source: intermediate/bipartite_nodes_all6.csv (52 rows chosen by diversity-aware farthest-first selection over composition and median position, per node_select.py), consensus_scope_clusters.csv (513), edges endpoint union (519)

viz_units.name: Gate bullet chart (four conditions)
viz_units.what_it_shows: The paper's central caveat, operationalised: each of the four gate conditions as a value against its threshold, ABOVE the story rather than behind a toggle.
viz_units.encoding: Four stacked bullet charts. Each: a bar for the value, a vertical reference tick for the threshold, the population distribution as a faint backdrop, and a pass/fail glyph. Thresholds printed: clade_concentration < 0.35, n_indep_clades >= 8, npmi_mip_APC > 0.10, co_count >= 10.
viz_units.data_source: phylo_corrected_candidates.csv / protein_utr_FINAL_scores.csv. Measured distributions on the 2,620 passing edges for the backdrops: n_indep_clades min 8 / median 13 / max 23; n_indep_families min 9 / median 38 / max 143; clade_concentration mean 0.265, zero above 0.50; frac_co_ZNF max 0.400, only 11 edges above 0.30.
interactions: hover -> the exact value, the threshold and the percentile among passing edges

viz_units.name: ZNF fraction badge
viz_units.what_it_shows: How much of this edge's co-occurrence comes from the KRAB-ZNF expansion.
viz_units.encoding: A small badge, neutral below 0.10, amber 0.10-0.30, strong amber above 0.30 (only 11 of 2,620 edges). Module-level version uses mean_frac_ZNF (M1 0.062, M2 0.042, M3 0.003, M4 0.027, M5 0.014, M6 0.002).
viz_units.data_source: phylo_corrected_candidates.csv frac_co_ZNF; modules.json mean_frac_ZNF
interactions: click -> #/evidence/paralogy with this edge pinned as the example

viz_units.name: Consensus pair row
viz_units.what_it_shows: Which specific consensus strings drive an edge - the most scientifically informative detail in the portal.
viz_units.encoding: Two mini-logos side by side with their consensus strings between them, then the consensus-level statistics (co_count, npmi_mip_APC, n_indep_clades) and both coverages.
viz_units.data_source: /Users/wangyanz/Desktop/Project/sequence_design/manuscript/main_figures_code/figure3_4/motif_pair_network/intermediate/consensus_pair_scores.csv.gz (49,547 rows x 22 columns: p_cid, u_cid, p_cluster, u_cluster, module, p_consensus, u_consensus, p_coverage, u_coverage, p_carriers, u_carriers, co_count, npmi_raw, npmi_mip_APC, n_indep_clades, clade_concentration, frac_co_ZNF, passes_phylo_filter, phylo_corrected_score, cl_npmi_mip_APC, cl_passes, cl_n_indep_clades). BAKE: filter to cl_passes, sort by phylo_corrected_score, keep top 3 per (p_cluster, u_cluster) -> a measured 3,599 rows / 703 KB.
interactions: click either consensus -> its cluster page pinned to that consensus
'show the shared carrier genes' -> the bitwise AND list
viz_units.coverage_note: Only 1,430 of 2,620 edges (54.6%) have a consensus pair, and ZERO cross-module edges do. The drawer therefore degrades in three labelled tiers and never shows an empty panel. Bake step P9 (bitwise AND over consensus_presence.npz) would close this.
